c77f86cc.en: Gap: neither source names which specific active skills Chanter should target on Chalice-equivalent cards, unlike Cleric's Chalice skill list (Forge, Swift Heal, Earth's Retribution, and so on). Both sources address which stat-category (Frenzy/Purity/Vigor/Magic) goes on which slot, not which active skills to slot.

4e568c27.en: Avoid: the general system-level guidance from the Cleric-side Arcana research (presumably applicable but not independently confirmed for Chanter) is don't over-invest in expensive Vitality-type cards from scratch, and lock rather than delete old cards since metas shift with patches.

6bccc632.en: Battle Chanter goes Critical Hit and Physical Attack; support Chanter goes for buff uptime and survivability over raw damage.

abeab103.en: Weapon: Staff, used for both offense and, per one source, an in-class block mechanic, removing the need for a shield swap.

8c1eceb2.en: Do first (offensive / "Battle Chanter"): Critical Hit and Physical Attack for damage per hit and faster mob clearing, plus Critical Hit and Accuracy so crowd-control effects land reliably single source aggregation.

eeae8a3e.en: Then (support Chanter): gear that "enhances your support toolkit" over top-tier DPS stats, since "your value comes from survivability and consistent buff uptime."

8dd16fa9.en: Later / optional: a note of uncertain provenance for AION 2 suggests Magic Boost is only a secondary stat for Chanter, since the class is fundamentally physical low confidence, possible AION 1 conflation

53712b8f.en: Possibly carried over from original-AION guidance.

07c710c3.en: Physical Attack, Critical Hit, and Attack Speed are the suggested primary stats.

607aa953.en: aion2boost.com's build philosophy: "Uptime matters most, a weaker buff maintained consistently outperforms a stronger one that lapses," implying Cooldown Reduction and buff-duration stats should be weighed alongside raw damage stats for a support-oriented Chanter ⟦1⟧.

4784d2eb.en: Gap: no reliable source found for which specific gear piece to enhance first for Chanter, nor for named set-effect gear pieces (unlike Cleric, no player-submitted example build page was found). No reliable source found for a manastone/godstone-equivalent socketing system specific to Chanter.

b641b61b.en: Apply Strike Chain for guaranteed stun and damage over time.

a0192c33.en: Drop a regen zone for sustain.

Treat exact skill names as provisional.

10f4492e.en: A second phrasing closer to AION2 Hub's own description: open with staff combos including Onslaught, Resonance Crush, Impactful Crush, and Crushing Blow to apply physical damage and debuffs, while "life-leech and stat-boosting mantras" maintain party viability ⟦1⟧.

6c21492e.en: Again this skill-name set does not overlap cleanly with the Vortex guide's names.

a6da663d.en: Animation canceling combo single source: "Crushing Wave and then use a skill based on left-click or Source of Recovery" is cited as a rapid-execution animation-cancel sequence; the guide itself stresses this reflects "personal opinion and not the definitive answer" ⟦1⟧.

fc768b19.en: Mantra/aura upkeep moderate confidence, single source: Chanter's signature mechanic is the mantra system, buffs that are instantly cast, persist until manually cancelled or replaced (not on a timer, and "cannot be dispelled by any means"), and act as an aura benefiting the whole nearby group by proximity.

6fb31591.en: Up to three mantras can be active solo, or four if grouped with a second Chanter.

38b6b1d0.en: This may partly describe original-AION mantra mechanics carried into AION 2.

4d4177ef.en: Party composition should steer mantra choice: a caster-heavy party benefits from magic-boosting mantras, a melee-heavy party benefits from physical attack power/critical rate mantras.

0f4e0bd4.en: Beginner tip: always recast mantras immediately after death/respawn, since they drop and are not automatically restored.

707c9d99.en: Gap: no reliable source found with a named Chanter defensive cooldown analogous to Cleric's Immortal Curtain, or a confirmed auto-hunt skill setup for Chanter.

fb40174c.en: Chanter levels solo just fine numerically, but its buffing identity only shows up in a group.

28662c74.en: Solo leveling comfort is generally rated positively for raw survival and clear speed, "fast mob clearing and excellent sustainability" thanks to built-in sustain and crowd control marketing, lower trust.

6eed64df.en: But aion2boost.com's more skeptical framing should be weighed against this: Chanter's identity is built around buffing others, so solo leveling, while numerically fine, does not showcase the class's actual strength and may feel comparatively flat next to classes fully usable alone ⟦1⟧.

b24a6c48.en: Sustain: regen zones plus life-leech mantras give consistent self-sustain without heavy potion use, similar in spirit to Cleric's self-healing but delivered as an AoE zone rather than an instant heal.

5d56c834.en: This means Chanter benefits from standing in its own zone rather than kiting constantly (inferred from Fextralife's "lacks instant single-target heals but excels with AoE regeneration zones" note, moderate confidence).

c3355d8a.en: "Turns on" point: aion2boost.com's grading suggests Chanter turns on specifically when joining an organized/premade group rather than at any particular character level or gear milestone; its value is structurally tied to having allies present to buff.

69746051.en: Gap: no reliable source found for a specific level or CP number where Chanter's personal (non-buff) power spikes, beyond the single Korean-community note that roughly 2200 combat power is enough to function as a main-healer substitute in easier content. No reliable source found for specific mob-density or pulling-size comfort numbers.

5414e27d.en: ⟦1⟧ Create your account and install the client via Steam or PURPLE ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧

0b06eccf.en: AION 2 is PC-only at global launch, playable through Steam or NCsoft's PURPLE launcher. No console or mobile version exists for the West yet.

05f9ecd7.en: ⟦1⟧ Pick faction and server together with any friends before you log in ⟦2⟧

2ee99787.en: Faction and server choice is effectively permanent, and Legions (guilds) are faction-locked, so this decides who you can play with.

05d3be70.en: ⟦1⟧ Pick your class, tank, melee or ranged DPS, magic DPS, healer, or support ⟦2⟧ marketing

2b4e3f9a.en: Eight classes exist: Templar (tank), Gladiator and Assassin (melee DPS), Ranger (ranged DPS), Sorcerer and Spiritmaster (magic DPS), Cleric (healer), and Chanter (hybrid support).

5071130a.en: ⟦1⟧ Play the free Launch Scale Test, September 17 to 18, 2026 ⟦2⟧

a8d7245f.en: This is open to anyone via Steam sign-up and is your first real chance to test performance and settings before launch.

f6aa5b1c.en: ⟦1⟧ Decide, buy or skip the Founder's Pack ⟦2⟧ single source

3ff57e31.en: Standard ($24.99) bundles 5 days of Advance Access plus 30 days of Membership, the same account-affecting items as Deluxe and Ultimate, which only add cosmetics.

d2bbec0a.en: ⟦1⟧ If buying, preload around Sept 28 and log in during Advance Access, Sept 30 to Oct 4 ⟦2⟧

c11d6d0c.en: Advance Access is a 5-day head start before the public October 5 global launch.

5dc40652.en: ⟦1⟧ Confirm your PC meets minimum spec, Ryzen 5 2600 or i5-10500, GTX 1050 Ti ⟦2⟧ single source

0fca26b9.en: Recommended is Ryzen 7 3700X or i7-11700, 16GB RAM, RTX 2070, worth checking against your rig now rather than on launch day.

72901873.en: ⟦1⟧ Decide whether the $15 a month Membership fits your plans ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧

e1d7f4c1.en: Membership is optional to play at all, but it gates trading on the Market and the Kinah to Quna currency exchange.

8dae13f6.en: ⟦1⟧ Save your keybind and settings changes before your first real fight ⟦2⟧ marketing

5e18a4b2.en: Moving Defiance off Spacebar, binding Sprint to Shift, and enabling combat overlays are a starting point to tweak in the Launch Scale Test, not gospel.

aa7cdf21.en: Done when: your faction, server, class, and Founder's Pack decisions are made, and you have logged in at least once during the Launch Scale Test or Advance Access.

473c2cd3.en: Get moving without wasting anything you cannot get back. Level 1 to about 12, your first few hours.

0da48ff3.en: ⟦1⟧ Clear your first Sealed Dungeon in your starter region ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧

8a29fb1b.en: Sealed Dungeons in Verteron and Altgard are solo, ungated by gear score, and pay out Daevanion Points from your very first hours.

c7e8500d.en: ⟦1⟧ Level your main damage skill to skill-level 8 ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧

da5ada50.en: Skills gain bonus chosen effects at level 8, 12, and 16, so a skill lagging behind these breakpoints will feel weak.

cee232cb.en: ⟦1⟧ Unlock your wings, reported around level 10 ⟦2⟧ single source

a15bbfb7.en: Flight is a core combat and traversal mechanic, not just cosmetic transport, and some Abyss boss mechanics reportedly require it.

18b3602b.en: ⟦1⟧ Test a Mastery Skill respec at least once ⟦2⟧ single source

eccd3553.en: Skill Points refund for a small Kinah fee, so trying a different core skill early carries little risk.

f844e8c1.en: ⟦1⟧ Hold at least one Shugo Fiesta key unspent ⟦2⟧ single source

3f14a088.en: Spending limited daily keys before reaching max level reduces their endgame reward value.

f6a5f02c.en: This is when your first Daevanion board, Nezekan, becomes available, a good marker that you are through the opening hours.

fe540994.en: ⟦1⟧ Keep Odyle Energy below its reported 560 cap ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ kr-era

90fdad80.en: Passive regeneration stops once the pool is full, so sitting capped wastes potential income.

bbb664b8.en: ⟦1⟧ Clear all 7 of your weekly Daily Dungeon entries ⟦2⟧ contested

13ed8f14.en: One source cites 7 free entries a week, expandable via tickets, but exact weekly counts vary between sources, so verify in-client.

4c8a20da.en: ⟦1⟧ Equip a free stat title you already qualify for ⟦2⟧

b88952da.en: Check the achievement panel periodically for cheap stat titles rather than actively farming them. Titles come from PvP rank, Arena tiers, boss kills, and more.

dac3412f.en: ⟦1⟧ Reconfirm your Membership decision now that trading matters ⟦2⟧ official

a88fabe9.en: The $15 a month Membership gates the player Market and the Kinah to Quna currency exchange.

42fc6e8a.en: ⟦1⟧ Enhance your weapon to +8, the first safe damage breakpoint ⟦2⟧ single source

b694ca33.en: Pushing enhancement further on gear you might replace soon wastes scarce Enhance Stones. +8 is described as a damage-smoothing milestone, especially for weapons.

852f0755.en: ⟦1⟧ Decide whether to roll an alt now that clears feel fast ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧

c8217198.en: Per-character systems like Battle Pass, Stigma builds, and gear do not share progress across characters, and an 84-run account-wide weekly soft cap discourages heavy alt farming for Kinah.

56c2485c.en: Done when: you have a repeatable weekly checklist you actually finish most weeks, and you have made a deliberate Membership and alt decision rather than drifting into one.

14001d7c.en: Check every KR-era assumption above against what actually ships on October 5, 2026.

61a5a48c.en: NC has not clarified which cap number applies at global launch.

00b6d7e3.en: ⟦1⟧ Confirm the Stigma unlock level and slot count in the client, KR: level 23, 4 slots ⟦2⟧ kr-era single source

b8528204.en: The source itself flags that this figure could change for global.

c86da6cc.en: ⟦1⟧ Confirm your weekly dungeon entry limits in the client ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ contested

d0650c4f.en: This guide is built from search and page fetches, not hands-on play, and treats KR/TW numbers as directional, not final.

8351f606.en: This guide was compiled on September 12, 2026, roughly three weeks before global launch, using web search and page fetches rather than hands-on play, since the global client does not exist yet.

58056729.en: Topics were researched separately: the general overview, systems, monetization, and dungeons/energy topics, and one per class. Every claim is linked inline and badged by confidence.

8c7af3e0.en: Search for recent AION 2 coverage on the target topic.

d7fb2e69.en: Fetch the most promising pages directly.

2918b5fc.en: Fall back to search-engine result snippets when a fetch failed (a large number did, mostly HTTP 403 from boosting and VPN-marketing sites that block automated readers).

a3663657.en: Every claim was tagged at the point of writing as confirmed, single source, or contested, based on how many independent sources agreed. It was separately flagged KR-era whenever a number could only be traced to the Korean or Taiwanese live client rather than an official global statement.

a01e28b1.en: The single biggest limitation running through this entire guide is the KR/TW-versus-global gap. AION 2 has been live in Korea and Taiwan since November 2025, so almost every specific number here, from skill breakpoints to dungeon entry limits to Stigma slot counts, was measured on that client.

4ec19c4d.en: Global launches October 5, 2026 with its own balance pass (NC has already announced changes like no Heroic-gear drops and different item-level gates), so treat every KR-era number as a reasonable starting guess, not a locked-in fact.

59455d6e.en: No fact in this guide was invented to fill a gap. Where research genuinely turned up nothing, the relevant card says "no reliable source found" rather than guessing, and those gaps are collected in the Known unknowns card above so they are easy to re-check once Founder access opens on September 30, 2026 and the client is actually in players' hands.

f284225d.en: Citation reliability: a random sample of 20 sourced sentences was re-checked against the linked pages; 15 were fully supported, 1 partially (correct skill names, grouping added by this guide), and 3 pointed at a page that did not carry the claim. Assume a residual error rate of roughly one in seven chips: click through before acting on any specific number.

657f0a65.en: Korean-language community sources (inven.co.kr, namu.wiki, dcinside, fmkorea, arca.live) were targeted deliberately, since KR/TW players have a ten-month head start on every mechanic in this game.

f1bbea5e.en: Most direct fetches of those sites returned HTTP 403. Where their content shows up here at all, it is relayed through an English-language guide that cites them, or through a search-engine snippet, never a verified direct read.

8d045bcd.en: Earned alongside Daevanion Points from the same sources, also obtainable via material conversion; feeds Daevanion board progression. ⟦1⟧

d3703f17.en: A card-based system adding Item Level, combat stats, set bonuses, and effective skill levels at once. Slots include Chalice, Parchment, Compass, Bell, and Mirror, later expanded. ⟦1⟧

75ac1ecd.en: A consumable that feeds experience to Arcana cards; tiers are Lesser (200 EXP), Intermediate (600), Superior (1,500), and Ultimate (3,000). ⟦1⟧

b1dcbe32.en: Alongside Mana Stones, described as helping gear "scale into late-game without major farming" by increasing attribute effects. ⟦1⟧

821a06b9.en: Spent to raise a gear piece's enhancement level. Extraction from a previously-enhanced item refunds 100% of the Enhance Stones spent into it. ⟦1⟧

0113367a.en: AION 2's player marketplace/Auction House; Kinah is the only currency usable there. ⟦1⟧

5f676f4f.en: Granted by completing achievements; ties into Daevanion Point/Crystal income. ⟦1⟧

92e6fe3c.en: A monster drop; farming 10 souls of almost any monster unlocks it as a pet/mount. Also drops from the Shugo Shop and Black Cloud Merchant. ⟦1⟧

3525e06a.en: A wing's airborne stamina stat, managed via a physics-based "Glide Gauge" rather than a rigid timer. ⟦1⟧

eafc4087.en: AION 2's guild system, capped at up to 128 members, used for PvE, PvP, crafting, and social access. ⟦1⟧

aef6680b.en: Unlocks at Legion level 5, costs 1,000,000 Kinah to rent, houses all five crafting professions' merchants/workbenches together. ⟦1⟧

98198a42.en: Earned for active Legion contribution; spent on Legion-exclusive skins, uniforms, masks, mounts, and wings. ⟦1⟧

ade83439.en: Governs the chance to land an attack; per one source, also affects crit chance. ⟦1⟧

84562c7b.en: A hybrid stat that raises both Accuracy and Crit chance. ⟦1⟧
